info.title: Company Central Platform API
info.description:
Shared infrastructure every business system in the company depends on:
identity, organization, authorization, security, audit, workflow,
notifications and documents.

## Authenticating

**A person** signs in at `POST /api/v1/auth/login` and receives an access
token and a refresh token.

**A system** exchanges client credentials at `POST /api/v1/oauth/token`:

```
grant_type=client_credentials
client_id=ccp_...
client_secret=ccps_...
```

Add `on_behalf_of=<user id>` to act for a person. The resulting call is
allowed to do only what the application *and* that person may do.

Both kinds of token are signed with the same key and can be validated
locally against `/api/v1/.well-known/jwks.json`.

## Permissions

Every operation below states the permission it requires. Holding it is
necessary and not always sufficient — a permission is granted at a
*scope*, and the scope decides which records are in reach.

## Failures

Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents carrying a stable `code`. Match on
the code, never on the message: messages are translated and reworded, and
codes are not.

## Versioning

The path carries the version. What may change inside `v1` without notice,
and what cannot, is set out in `docs/api/versioning.md`. Endpoints on their
way out answer with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers before they stop.

get.summary: Confirms the API is reachable and returns the correlation id.
get.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: Returns each error category so the contract can be verified.
get.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: Returns a paged envelope so paging and sorting rules can be verified.
get.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: Raises an unhandled exception to verify the error boundary.
get.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

post.summary: Authenticates a user and starts a session.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

post.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

post.summary: Ends the current session, revoking its tokens server-side.
post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Changes the caller's password and ends their other sessions.
post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Requests a password reset link. Always succeeds, revealing nothing.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

post.summary: Redeems a reset token and sets a new password.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user's profile.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

put.summary: Chooses the language the Platform writes to the caller in.
put.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: Lists the caller's active sessions.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: Lists the caller's recent sign-in attempts, successful and failed.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: Lists users, filtered and paged.

post.summary: Creates a user who must change their password at first sign-in.
post.description:
**Requires:** `platform.users.create`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

get.summary: Returns one user.

put.summary: Updates a user's email and display name.

post.summary: Unlocks a user account.
post.description:
**Requires:** `platform.users.edit`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

get.summary: Public keys for validating Platform access tokens locally.
get.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: Lists the caller's permissions, for hiding controls they cannot use.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Answers whether a user holds a permission, and over what data.
post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Exchanges client credentials for a short-lived access token.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

put.summary: Records an application's complete permission manifest.
put.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Clears somebody else's second factor when they have lost it.
post.description:
**Requires:** `platform.security.manage`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

get.summary: Searches the security event log within a bounded time window.
Everything filed against one business record, as the caller may see it.

post.summary: Accepts a signed webhook from a registered provider.
post.description: **Anonymous.** No token is needed to call this.

get.summary: What the Platform sent, and what came back.
Whether a feature is on for the caller.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: Returns the company, or null when the Platform has not been set up yet.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

put.summary: Renames the company in both languages. Its code is fixed.

get.summary: Returns the company structure as a nested tree.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

put.summary: Renames a unit in both languages.

post.summary: Moves a unit and every descendant to a new parent, atomically.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

post.summary: Deactivates a unit that has no active children or employees.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

get.summary: Lists the company's job positions.

post.summary: Creates a job position.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

put.summary: Renames a position in both languages.

post.summary: Deactivates a position, or brings it back. Never deletes one.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.organization.manage`

get.summary: Lists employees, optionally scoped to a unit and everything beneath it.

post.summary: Creates an employee record.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.employees.manage`

post.summary: Moves an employee to a different unit, position or manager.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.employees.manage`

put.summary: Links or unlinks an employee's Platform account.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.roles.manage`

Returns one role with the permissions it carries.

Replaces the permissions a role carries, refusing any the caller does not hold.
put.description:
**Requires:** `platform.roles.manage`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

post.summary: Deactivates a role, or brings it back. Never deletes one.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.roles.manage`

get.summary: Lists a user's role assignments.

post.description:
**Requires:** `platform.roles.assign`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

delete.summary: Revokes a role assignment. Takes effect on the next request.
delete.description:
**Requires:** `platform.roles.assign`

post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Records many events at once, attributed to the calling application.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.audit.write`

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.workflow.manage`

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.workflow.manage`

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.workflow.start`

Returns one approval with everything that happened to it.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.workflow.start`

get.summary: The caller's approval inbox.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.workflow.manage`

get.summary: The caller's in-app inbox.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

post.summary: Marks one of the caller's own notifications as read.
post.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: What the caller has turned off. Absence means everything is on.
get.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

put.summary: Turns a category on or off. Security notifications are refused.
put.description: **Requires:** an authenticated caller, and no permission. This endpoint acts only on the caller's own records.

get.summary: Everything sent, with every delivery attempt. Failures surface here.
The template catalogue, one row per message per language.

put.summary: Writes or revises a template. Revising bumps its version.

get.summary: Documents the caller may see.

post.summary: Stores a file and the document that holds it.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.documents.create`

get.summary: One document, with every version of it.

put.summary: Renames a document, and moves it if the caller may.

delete.summary: Marks a document for deletion. Content survives the grace period.

get.summary: The content, by redirect to storage or streamed from here.
Who opened this document, and who tried and could not.

post.summary: Adds a version. The previous one stays downloadable.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.documents.update`

post.summary: Takes back a deletion, inside the grace period.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.documents.delete`

get.summary: Who else can see this document.

put.summary: Shares a document, or changes what somebody already has.

get.summary: What this document is filed against.

post.description: **Requires:** `platform.documents.update`

get.summary: Every external service the Platform may call.

post.description:
**Requires:** `platform.integrations.manage`

**Second factor required.** The caller must have completed a step-up challenge recently; otherwise this answers 403 with `SECURITY.STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

Stops calls to a provider, or starts them again.

post.summary: Adds an operation to a provider.
post.description: **Requires:** `platform.integrations.manage`

get.summary: How each provider has been behaving, from its recent calls.
Every declared setting, and what has been set for it.

put.summary: Declares a setting, or updates its description and constraints.
Sets a value at a scope, or clears the override.

get.summary: What this setting was, what it became, who changed it and when.
Every declared flag and its switch.

put.summary: Declares a flag. It is off until somebody turns it on.
Turns a flag on or off, and decides who it reaches.

get.summary: Every background job, when it last ran and how it went.
The recent runs of one background job, newest first.
How many integration events are undelivered, and how old the oldest is.
